title: bee knowledge bootstrap stands up a bundle in a host repo
action: Per U9: new verb `bee knowledge bootstrap` — in a repo with docs/specs/*.md and NO bundle, creates docs/knowledge/: one bee.area concept per spec (spec body imported under the area, OKF frontmatter authored: type, title, description from first heading/paragraph, timestamp, bee.id/areas/authoritative_for), plus generated index.md and subdir indexes via the existing index machinery. Typed refusal when a bundle already exists (bundle_mode true) or docs/specs is absent/empty — refusal names what to do instead. Output names each area created and the gaps (specs it could not classify). Register in routing try_native + hand-maintained registry payload (ks-1 precedent), keep tests/registry_contracts.rs green. TDD on temp-dir fixtures: fresh bootstrap, existing-bundle refusal, no-specs refusal, frontmatter validity via check_bundle.

truths: Fresh host fixture: bootstrap creates a bundle that knowledge check accepts and bundle_mode reads true
Existing bundle: typed refusal, zero writes

artifacts.substantive: full verb with tests, no stubs

key_links: registry payload carries knowledge.bootstrap; routing dispatches it
